rows.ARS:
Medium red Floribunda.
Exhibition name: Little Red Hedge
rows.Origin:
Bred by W. Kordes & Sons (Germany, before 1983).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses as 'Little Red Hedge'.
rows.Bloom: Carmine-red. None / no fragrance. Double (17-25 petals) bloom form.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: Zimbabwe patent application No. 8839 on April 25, 1988
